action_convention.boundary_bookkeeping: The displayed slab density assumes the conventional EH+GHY cancellation of radial total derivatives. Finite brane potentials, orientations, orbifold factors, bending and junction terms remain an explicit separate gate.

bounded_execution_contract.representation: degree-four coefficient jets with DAG common-subexpression elimination; stream radial quadrature
bounded_execution_contract.required_projection: only h0^4 and h0^2*ha exchange channels on nested 3/5/7 modes

constraint_solution_contract.second_order_closure_falsifier: Before restricting the shift, project the second-order momentum constraint transversely. If P_T C^(2) is nonzero, add N_m^T. Likewise retain the induced TT metric as an exchange channel, not as a direct scalar contact.

evidence_boundary: This certificate derives and checks the exact local bulk ADM vehicle that can generate quartic vertices. It does not yet solve constraints, include the physical finite boundaries, project a compact S3/S4, or support a new-force claim.

exact_density.C_mn: partial_m partial_n beta-zeta_m beta_n-zeta_n beta_m+eta_mn*(partial zeta dot partial beta)
exact_density.lapse_eliminated_density: L_onN=2*sqrt(-gamma)*(R4-V)*sqrt(Q/(R4-V)) on the continuous N>0 branch; writing +2*sqrt[Q*(R4-V)] also requires Q and R4-V to be positive
exact_density.momentum_constraint: D_n{N^-1*[3H*delta^n_m+B^n_m-delta^n_m*tr(B)]}=0 in unitary gauge; it remains to be solved for beta before any physical vertex projection
exact_density.positive_lapse_branch: N^2=Q/(R4-V), only where the ratio is positive; do not choose a square-root sign independently across a zero

next_decisive_test: Solve lapse and shift consistently, recover the certified S2 operator and normalization in these variables, then compare c000 with the BMP bulk oracle before adding finite-endpoint terms.
